faceCalibrationMode.purpose: Prove that Sarah likeness and HeroCel animation-model rendering can coexist before any further full-body HeroCel generation.
faceCalibrationMode.geometrySource: Sarallel Likeness Master A remains absolute; no generated calibration portrait may supersede real-photo-derived geometry authority.
faceCalibrationMode.designSource: Use only the upper-torso armor geometry already approved in Sarallel Design Master A.
faceCalibrationMode.presentation: single neutral or warm-soft-smile upper-torso portrait on a plain neutral background; no sheet, no labels, no alternate views, no FX
faceCalibrationMode.promotionRule: Do not return to full-body Sarallel HeroCel production until one face calibration simultaneously passes Sarah likeness and HeroCel animation-model rendering floors.

renderingOnlyTargets.facialValueGrouping: 2-to-3 major skin value groups with clean readable planes while preserving all Sarah geometry
renderingOnlyTargets.facialTransitionBands: maximum one restrained transition band between major skin value groups
renderingOnlyTargets.skinRendering: animation-model-first; no airbrushed skin and no continuous photographic gradients
renderingOnlyTargets.shadowBoundary: crisp controlled shadow boundaries with selective softness only where absolutely necessary
renderingOnlyTargets.edgeTreatment: crisp controlled animated-character edges; facial feature separation without heavy comic inking
renderingOnlyTargets.eyeTreatment: increase contrast, catchlight, iris and lid readability only; never alter Sarah eye size, shape, spacing, tilt, or lid geometry
renderingOnlyTargets.noseTreatment: simplify into a few clear light/shadow planes only; never narrow, sharpen, lengthen, or reshape the nose
renderingOnlyTargets.mouthTreatment: simplify contour, local shadow, and highlight treatment only; preserve mouth width, lip proportions, and Sarah smile construction
renderingOnlyTargets.cheekJawTreatment: reduce surface modeling noise only; preserve cheek fullness, jaw width, and rounded chin
renderingOnlyTargets.hairTreatment: group hair into large animation-readable masses with selective strand accents only; preserve hairline, part, length family, and face framing
renderingOnlyTargets.hairMicrodetailRule: strand-by-strand rendering may not be the primary hair language
renderingOnlyTargets.armorTreatment: 2-to-4 major value groups per material, graphic material separation, deliberate highlight bands, minimal gloss gradients, no geometry redesign
renderingOnlyTargets.crystalTreatment: when later reintroduced, high-contrast focal material with clean internal facets; preserve crystal geometry and placement
renderingOnlyTargets.detailHierarchy: face first, primary upper-torso crystal/armor landmarks second, hair silhouette third, secondary microdetail last

animationModelFirewall.requiredRead: clean premium animated game character, not painted fantasy portraiture
hardReject: continuous soft facial gradients as the primary form language
strand-by-strand hair rendering as the dominant hair treatment
realistic glossy armor gradients dominating over graphic value blocks
illustration polish that weakens animation-model readability
soft rendering that could plausibly belong to a different artist than Kineza and Prismel HeroCel
beauty normalization that weakens Sarah likeness
hair curl-pattern redesign that changes Sarah appearance
Kineza or other HeroCel calibration-character geometry transfer
strong likeness with insufficient HeroCel animation rendering
strong HeroCel rendering with insufficient Sarah likeness

Do not normalize Sarah toward a generic animated heroine and do not soften HeroCel back into painted fantasy portraiture.
generationContract.geometryInstruction: No facial, hair, body-identity, or upper-torso costume geometry may be redesigned for style consistency.
generationContract.styleInstruction: Push rendering decisively into HeroCel: 2-to-3 facial value groups, crisp graphic shadows, simplified nose and mouth planes, grouped hair masses, controlled edge hierarchy, and graphic armor value blocks with restrained highlights.
